card.summary: Free Forever video plan: 60 storage minutes, 100 GB bandwidth/mo, 60 mins live streaming/mo, 1 seat. Storage minutes are minutes of uploaded video, not bytes...

free_tier.stated: Free Forever video plan: 60 storage minutes, 100 GB bandwidth/mo, 60 mins live streaming/mo, 1 seat. Storage minutes are minutes of uploaded video, not bytes; original images are not stored.

egress.terms: 100 GB/month bandwidth on free (generous), then metered.

record.tooling: REST upload plus URL transformations, S3 source pull.
record.chaining: Unlimited free accounts x 60 storage minutes. A video-minute is a terrible unit for binary storage: 60 min at 1080p is ~1-4 GB and everything is transcoded, never stored as original bytes.
record.limits_note: 60 storage mins, 100 GB/mo bandwidth, 60 mins live streaming. All assets transcoded to adaptive bitrate.
record.reliability_note: Transcodes by design; originals are not the delivered artifact. Unusable for byte-exact storage.

dead_end.why: 60 storage minutes of video, not bytes. No meaningful free image allowance — this is a video-first CDN.
